summary: Tested Video Calls Enhancements: Push notifications on call-request, recordings sync, recordings list, and recording access-link endpoints. All 9 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend tests passed - RecordingsPage loads correctly with header, sync button, empty state, and VideoCallsPage Recordings tab shows 'Open Recordings' button linking to /recordings.
critical_code_review_comments: Push notification code in call-request endpoint is properly wrapped in try/except to prevent crashes when no device tokens are registered
Recordings sync endpoint correctly queries Daily.co API and updates local room records
Recording access-link endpoint properly requires admin role before querying Daily.co
RecordingsPage has proper data-testid attributes for testing
VideoCallsPage Recordings tab correctly links to /recordings page
seed_data_creation: Multiple test call requests created during testing (visible in IncomingCallBanner)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video Calls Enhancements tested. New endpoints: POST /api/video-calls/recordings/sync (admin only, syncs from Daily.co), GET /api/video-calls/recordings (returns recordings list), GET /api/video-calls/recordings/{recording_id}/access-link (admin only, gets playback link). Push notifications on call-request work but log 'No active admin device tokens' in preview (expected). RecordingsPage data-testid attributes: recordings-page, recordings-back-btn, sync-recordings-btn, no-recordings-state, sync-empty-btn, recording-player, close-player-btn, recording-video-element, recording-card-{room_name}, play-btn-{room_name}, download-btn-{room_name}. VideoCallsPage has open-recordings-page-btn in Recordings tab.

features_tested.backend_call_request_triggers_push_no_cr: PASS - Endpoint succeeds, logs show push attempt
features_tested.frontend_video_calls_page_loads: PASS - Page loads with Active/History/Recordings tabs
